integrity.capacity_matching_audit: free_baseline uses the same A bound, q grid, profile loss, observation grid, and deterministic enumerative c solver; c=-k0 reproduces the invariant response for fixed q,A
integrity.singleton_q_equivalence_audit: on a singleton residual grid, invariant MAP, uniform ensemble, and evidence-weighted mixture predictions must agree

matched_free.A_profile: same bounded closed-form profile as invariant policies for every (c,q)
matched_free.policy_role: free_baseline; uniform ensemble over q after deterministic c,A profiling for each q
matched_free.response: y_cq(x)=y0*exp(cT*x)+A*z_cq(x), where z_cq is the fixed-grid convolution of exp(cT*(x-s)) with g_q(s)
matched_free.solver: enumerate the 61 predeclared cT values for each q; choose minimum prefix profile loss with ties within 1e-12 resolved by smaller cT then lower q index

noise.standardized_master_noise: one shared realization per latent task across prefix exposures

policies.evidence_weighted_residual_mixture: bounded A profile at every q, then weights proportional to exp[-(loss-loss_min)] over the common q grid
policies.free_baseline: matched-free uniform residual ensemble defined in matched_free
policies.invariant_residual_ensemble: bounded A profile at every q, then uniform average over the common q grid
policies.invariant_residual_MAP: bounded A profile at every q, then select minimum prefix-loss q with ties within 1e-12 resolved by lower q index
